name: @mercatus-liber/promotions
description: Coupon codes and percentage/fixed discounts, cart-level and product-level (subsystem 16). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports @mercatus-liber/cart, @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders, or @mercatus-liber/catalog. Product-scope promotions store bare skuId strings and are validated against a cart's own line items at evaluation time, not resolved through catalog. Publishes promotions.redeemed; subscribes to checkout.order.paid to increment redemption counts on completed purchases only.
